title: [3.0-beta1] TempT command from the watch cause "out of hard limit" error.
body:
AAPS 3.0-beta1 6072cd8a6-2021.10.17 in Samsung Galaxy S9 / Android 10
Wear OS watchface in TicWatch Pro

TempT command 5.5 mmol/l from the watch cause an error  "Temporary target bottom value is out of hard limits.
1782.00 limited to 180.00

Looks like there is an extra multiplier (x18) somewhere in the code.
